interpretation.central_result: The evidence-stratified failures of G_cog are recovered by the pre-existing claim/context architecture at every evidence level. This supports separation of system structure from scientific assertion semantics and source context rather than expansion of the cognitive-system role inventory.
interpretation.limitation: L_claim is intentionally a broad scientific assertion layer, not a fully formalized logic. Therefore 100% architecture placement tests boundary adequacy, not a theorem of unique/minimal or fully formal claim-language completeness.
interpretation.formalization_implication: The remaining PVS pressure is toward a more explicit ClaimIR/L_claim carrier for assertion references, not toward Grammar-v1.
